review_evidence: README identifies the source as a Lean 4 port of the Haskell Megaparsec parser package and documents parser construction and use.
A complete scan of all 25 Lean files found 132 declaration-style lines and no theorem, lemma, axiom, or proposition-example declarations.

Megaparsec/Parsec.lean and companion modules implement ParsecT, parser state, error bundles, stream interfaces, monadic instances and executable parsing functions; the source does not state or prove parser laws, parser correctness, or an independent object-language semantics.

source_action.content_invariant: The 25 Lean files implement parser-combinator APIs, state/error machinery and executable parsing, with no proposition declarations or independently proved parser specification. Retiring the source therefore removes no unique mathematical theorem/proof, formal specification, or formal-semantics corpus.
